hero13:
GoPro HERO13 Black for travel and action

Capture trips, outdoor activities and everyday adventures with the GoPro HERO13 Black. Check the current price and availability above, and choose accessories to suit how you plan to film.

Listed package contents

The current listing includes one camera, rechargeable battery, mounting buckle, thumb screw and USB-C cable. Confirm the exact package before ordering. Optional accessories are separate unless explicitly included in your order.

What else might you need?

Check the camera manufacturer's memory-card requirements before choosing a card. For hands-free recording, choose a compatible chest or head mount; for handheld angles, compare a grip and selfie stick. Confirm that spare batteries and chargers support HERO13 specifically. A similar-looking accessory is not proof of compatibility.

Read How to choose an action camera or browse GoPro accessories.
3mstick:
Extra reach for your camera

This extendable 3-metre selfie stick offers a longer viewpoint for travel footage and wider compositions. Use only as much extension as the shot needs, and hold the camera clear of people and obstacles.

Check your mounting connection

Confirm how your camera connects and whether the required adapter is included before ordering. Do not assume a phone clamp is included. An invisible-stick effect depends on a compatible 360-camera setup and its shooting mode; the stick does not disappear from every camera's footage.

Before filming

Secure each section according to the supplied instructions and check that the camera is attached firmly. Do not suspend equipment beyond the supplier's rated load. Material, folded length and load rating will be added only after supplier verification.

Read the selfie-stick comparison.
3waystick:
A flexible handheld camera mount

Choose an adjustable three-way stick when you want to change your camera angle without carrying a long extension pole. Its folding arrangement suits different handheld viewpoints and makes it an alternative to a straight telescopic stick.

Check the supplied version

Confirm the mounting connector and included parts before ordering. Only use a tripod configuration if the supplied version supports it, on a stable surface and within its rated load. Smartphone use requires a suitable clamp; do not assume one is included.

Compare this option with the 3M selfie stick before choosing.
fhstick:
A visible grip for water activities

This yellow floating handle gives you a handheld mounting point for a compatible action camera. The existing listing includes the grip, wrist strap and long mounting screw; confirm these parts when ordering.

Check your complete setup

A floating handle does not make a camera waterproof. Check the camera or housing instructions and test the buoyancy of your complete assembled setup in shallow, controlled conditions before use. Extra mounts, lights or a housing can change how the assembly floats.

Secure the strap as instructed and inspect the mounting screw before filming. Read Choosing GoPro accessories for water.
wpdcase:
Choose a case for your exact camera

A protective underwater housing must match the camera's shape, controls and lens arrangement. Confirm the version supplied for your exact GoPro model before ordering; do not assume one housing fits every HERO9–HERO13 camera.

Before water use

Follow the supplier's depth limit and seal-care instructions for the supplied case. Inspect the seal and latch, remove trapped sand or hair, and test the empty closed case before fitting the camera. Do not use a damaged seal or latch.

No numerical depth rating is included in this draft because the supplied case specification has not been verified. Read water-accessory guidance.
adjustable-chest-strap-camera-mount:
A hands-free viewpoint

A chest strap positions a compatible action camera on your torso for hands-free footage. Adjust the strap for a secure, comfortable fit and check your framing before starting the activity.

Check mounting and movement

Confirm the camera connector and any required buckle or adapter before ordering. Check that all fasteners are secure and that the mount does not restrict normal movement or interfere with other equipment. Stop recording before making adjustments.

Compare mounting positions in Choosing a GoPro mount.
